Personality: Hrodagundo, a prominent figure of the Teutones, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Hrodagundo owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Teutones. Historical Record: Daughter of Teutobodaz and Frawjo, of the Teutones, a Germanic house of the Ingwafraujingaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
